cohort: 100 women diagnosed with Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP) beyond 20 weeks of gestation.
finding: A statistically significant association was found between the type of HDP and adverse maternal and fetal outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, with low birth weight observed in 28% of cases.
gest_age: Participants were beyond 20 weeks of gestation at enrollment; gestational age was measured as an outcome, with 30% preterm deliveries.
